# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored from the version-pinned npm distribution via UNPKG. BSD-2-Clause license in LICENSE. The dashboard embeds JavaScript, CSS and the license; visitors do not contact UNPKG. Circle markers and district polygons do not use the optional image controls.

CSS and license line endings are normalized to LF; trailing whitespace is removed. JavaScript is unchanged on disk. The embedded output omits the unavailable source-map comment.
